title: Check your understanding: Dataset Management & Governance

items.prompt: How does Data Version Control (DVC) enable exact pipeline reproducibility without bloating Git repositories with gigabytes of binary data?
choices: It deletes earlier versions of data permanently when a new version is created
It stores cryptographic SHA-256 content hashes in lightweight pointer files tracked by Git, while storing large binaries in remote object storage
It converts all binary data into plain ASCII text inside Git commits
It compresses datasets using lossy JPEG encoding
items.explain: DVC computes SHA-256 hashes of datasets and tracks these small hash files in Git, while the actual heavy binary files are stored in object storage (e.g. S3).

items.prompt: How does cryptographic erasure (crypto-tombstoning) satisfy GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure) in immutable append-only columnar stores without rewriting large files?
choices: By physically destroying the hard drives hosting the database cluster
By encrypting each subject's data with a unique per-user key and destroying that key upon erasure, rendering the data provably unrecoverable random noise
By renaming the column headers to anonymous pseudonyms
By running an automated script to overwrite the text cells with blank spaces
items.explain: Crypto-tombstoning encrypts individual records with a unique per-subject encryption key. Destroying that key instantly renders the ciphertext unrecoverable random noise without rewriting massive immutable Parquet files.

items.prompt: In the standard 3-2-1 backup strategy for disaster recovery, what do the numbers represent?
choices: 3 days of retention, 2 operators on call, 1 password manager
3 total copies of the data, on 2 different physical media types, with 1 copy stored in a geographically isolated offsite location
3 petabytes of storage, 2 GPUs, 1 backup script
3 cloud vendors, 2 data engineers, 1 relational database
items.explain: The 3-2-1 rule dictates maintaining at least 3 total copies of data, across at least 2 different storage media types, with at least 1 copy held offsite.

items.prompt: Dynamic column masking in Role-Based Access Control allows ML engineers to train models on masked features without revealing raw personally identifiable information.
items.explain: Dynamic column masking intercepts queries and redacts sensitive PII attributes (like credit card numbers or patient names) based on user role permissions.

items.prompt: What is data debt, and how does immutable lineage tracking prevent it?
items.rubric: Data debt is the accumulation of unversioned, undocumented data modifications and silent upstream errors; lineage tracking records transformations and hashes to guarantee auditability and reproducibility.
items.sample_answer: Data debt is the accumulation of undocumented, unversioned data modifications that make ML systems irreproducible; lineage tracking documents every transformation and hash pointer from ingestion to deployment.
